title: admin allow_non_loopback=true still crashes daemon (flag contradicts admin.rs)
description: config.rs check_admin_addr() warns but allows start when allow_non_loopback=true and bearer_token=None. But admin.rs start_admin_server() FAILS unconditionally when addr is non-loopback and bearer_token is None, regardless of the flag. Operator following config docs gets a crash.
